
# Identifier Create Request

Request payload for creating a user identifier used for transaction reporting. Provide `type` and `issuing_country`; the `identifier` value is required unless the `identifier_standard` is `CONCAT`.

## Structure

`IdentifierCreateRequest`

## Fields

| Name | Type | Tags | Description |
|  --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Type` | [`Type7`](../../doc/models/type-7.md) | Required | Identifier type.<br><br>* NATIONAL_ID — national identity card number issued by the user's country.<br>* PASSPORT — passport number issued by the user's country.<br><br>**Default**: `Type7.NATIONAL_ID` |
| `IssuingCountry` | [`IssuingCountry`](../../doc/models/issuing-country.md) | Required | Accepted country code. [ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2). |
| `Identifier` | `string` | Optional | Identifier value. Omit this field when `identifier_standard` is `CONCAT`: the value is generated by Upvest from the user's name and date of birth. See the User identifiers guide ([TOL](https://docs.upvest.co/products/tol/guides/users/users_identifiers) / [BYOL](https://docs.upvest.co/products/byol/guides/users/users_identifiers)).<br><br>**Constraints**: *Minimum Length*: `0`, *Maximum Length*: `30` |
| `IdentifierStandard` | `string` | Optional | Identifier standard abbreviation. If it is not provided, the issuing country's 1st priority identifier standard is used by default. Use `CONCAT` to submit a CONCAT identifier. See the User identifiers guide ([TOL](https://docs.upvest.co/products/tol/guides/users/users_identifiers) / [BYOL](https://docs.upvest.co/products/byol/guides/users/users_identifiers)).<br><br>**Constraints**: *Maximum Length*: `6` |

## Example

```csharp
using UpvestInvestmentApi.Standard.Models;

IdentifierCreateRequest identifierCreateRequest = new IdentifierCreateRequest
{
    Type = Type7.NationalId,
    IssuingCountry = IssuingCountry.Aq,
    Identifier = "identifier2",
    IdentifierStandard = "identifier_standard2",
};
```
